name: Postsy
author: postsy

sections.description:
Postsy writes social media posts from the content you already have on your website. Pick a blog post, a page or up to three WooCommerce products, click “Make a post”, review the result, edit it and publish it now or schedule it for later – all inside wp-admin.

The plugin interface is in Polish. Postsy is a service for Polish small businesses.

  • Posts written by AI from your post, page or product (text, images, price and link).
  • Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn and Google Business Profile.
  • AI-generated images when your content has no photos, or your own images from the Media Library.
  • Carousels from several images.
  • Edit before publishing, then publish now or schedule a date and time.
  • Post history in the editor sidebar of every post and page.
  • Nothing is automatic: a post is created only when you click, and goes out only when you publish or schedule it.

Postsy is a paid service. You start with 500 free credits, no card and no time limit. Plans: https://postsy.pl/wordpress

External services

This plugin is a client for the Postsy service (https://postsy.pl/wordpress), run by Juliusz Drojecki, Poland. Post writing, AI images and publishing to social networks happen on Postsy servers. Without a Postsy account the plugin does nothing.

The plugin talks only to https://panel.postsy.pl, and only after you accept the Postsy terms on the plugin’s Start screen:

  • When you connect the site: the site domain, the wp-admin address, the address of the plugin’s verification endpoint and the e-mail you enter (or your Google sign-in, done in a Postsy window). Postsy calls the verification endpoint once to confirm you own the domain, then issues a site key stored in your WordPress options.
  • Right after connecting: the site name and tagline. Postsy reads your public website to fill in your business profile.
  • When you click “Make a post”: the title, text, selected images and, for products, price and link of the content you picked.
  • When you edit, publish, schedule or delete a post, change channels, plan or business profile, or send a support message: the data of that action.
  • On the plugin screens: your account status, posts and channels are read from Postsy.

Connecting Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn or Google, and paying for a plan (Stripe) happen in a Postsy window on panel.postsy.pl, not in WordPress.

Terms of service: https://postsy.pl/terms
Privacy policy: https://postsy.pl/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins > Add New, or upload the zip.
  2. Activate it and open Postsy in the admin menu.
  3. On the Start screen accept the terms and connect with your e-mail or Google. A Postsy account with 500 free credits is created for you.
  4. In Channels connect Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn or Google Business Profile.
  5. Open New post, pick your content and click “Make a post”.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Postsy account?

Yes. The account is created when you connect the site on the Start screen. You get 500 free credits to start, with no card and no time limit.

Does the plugin post anything automatically?

No. Posts are created only when you click, and published only when you publish or schedule them.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

The plugin removes its own settings from WordPress. Your Postsy account and posts stay in Postsy until you delete them there.
